arcs.title: The Duck Bandit
arcs.summary: Day 1: A fourth duck has appeared on the Jeep — yellow, slightly larger than its predecessors, wearing a small hat, secured with what appears to be a self-tightening Sticking Charm. No footprints, no note, no witness. The Duck Bandit's campaign is entering a new phase distinguished by millinery. Day 2 should introduce a possible clue — a thread, a smell, a pattern in the duck placement — without revealing the Bandit. The escalating hats are a throughline.
